assault_ships.description: A fleet of ships besieges the docks. If they fall, maritime reinforcements will not arrive in time. Destroy them without mercy.
assault_ships.failure_consequence: Reinforcements from Trinidad do not arrive. An escape route is lost.
assault_ships.failure_text: The sea is full of sharks. The sharks are full of... well, better not to think about it (；￣Д￣)
assault_ships.name: Assault on the Ships
assault_ships.success_consequence: Reinforcements from Trinidad arrive. 600 gold bonus to all participants.
assault_ships.success_text: The pirates sink with their ships! Let the fish feed on them ♪(´ε` )

defense_north_gate.description: Let us in! We want to have fun with you! We brought gifts for everyone! ✧｡٩(ˊᗜˋ )و✧*｡
defense_north_gate.failure_consequence: The gate is destroyed. New emergency activity: 'Evacuate the First Level'.
defense_north_gate.failure_text: The gifts were claws. The claws were deadly. The gate no longer exists. What a shame, they don't make doors like that anymore (╯°□°)╯︵ ┻━┻
defense_north_gate.name: Defense of the North Gate
defense_north_gate.success_consequence: Unlocks 'Investigate Catacombs'. 500 gold bonus to all participants.
defense_north_gate.success_text: The demons retreat howling! The gate holds. Santa Cruz still stands... for now (ง'̀-'́)ง

defense_south_wall.description: The demons advance relentlessly. The air is impregnated with the smell of gunpowder and blood. We are exhausted. But for our families and for God, we will resist.
defense_south_wall.failure_consequence: Breach in the south wall. New activity: 'Contain the Breach'.
defense_south_wall.failure_text: The wall fell. The demons enter. Should have brought more knights... (눈_눈)
defense_south_wall.name: Defense of the South Wall
defense_south_wall.success_consequence: South flank secured. 400 gold bonus to all participants.
defense_south_wall.success_text: The south is secured! Now it smells like victory... and a bit like sulfur, but mostly victory ᕙ(⇀‸↼‶)ᕗ

divine_quotes: “You will rise again, my son, for your duty is not yet finished...”
“Death is but a bridge to a greater purpose. Step back into the light...”
“The shadows may claim your flesh, but your soul belongs to the eternal fight...”
“Even in the deepest abyss, the ember of your will shall ignite the dawn...”
“Your lineage is etched in blood and gold; the grave cannot hold what destiny has chosen...”
“Walk through the valley of silence, and return with the thunder of redemption...”
“The heavens weep for your fall, yet the stars align for your rebirth...”
“The bell tolls not for your end, but for your awakening...”
“Your path is paved with the bones of those who gave up. Be not like them...”
“The fire that burns your flesh shall forge your spirit into a weapon...”
“The stars grow dim when your resolve wavers. Look up, and rise...”
“You are the heavy hammer of the Order; the world is the anvil...”
“Fate is a chain only you can break. Sunder it and return...”
“Silence is the sanctuary of the weak. Let your return be heard in the heavens...”
“The abyss consumes only what it can hold. Your soul is too vast for its hunger...”
“Every drop of blood spilled is a seed of vengeance yet to bloom...”
“The light of the heavens is blinding, but it shall guide you through the dark...”

q1.chaos: I marvel at the new form of the fragments and use them to create a mosaic or a spike trap. The breakage is an opportunity.
q1.order: I search for every speck of dust and use my will to restore its exact molecular structure. What was perfect must be perfect again.
q1.question: You find a millennial vase shattered to pieces. What is your reaction?

q2.chaos: The rebels'. I'd rather die in the explosion of uncertain change than live a life dictated by another's design.
q2.order: The crown's side. Disorder only brings hunger and death; the law is the only shield against the abyss.
q2.question: A kingdom lives in total peace, but under laws so strict that no one can choose their own profession. A violent revolution is brewing. Whose side are you on?

q3.chaos: I throw a small doctrine into the center to see what happens. If it explodes, at least I'll have learned something about its raw power.
q3.order: I build a series of containment seals and study its cycles for years before attempting to channel a single drop.
q3.question: You discover a flow of immense but totally unpredictable energy. What do you do?

q4.chaos: An untamed jungle full of strange hybrids that grow according to their own will, where every walk is a different adventure.
q4.order: A perfectly symmetrical design, with paths aligned to the stars and plants that bloom in strict chronological order.
q4.question: You are granted a barren land to create whatever you want. What is the final result?

q5.chaos: You shout 'Entropy!', throw the menu out the window, and decide you'll eat whatever you find first.
q5.order: You devise a weighted voting system by seniority and hunger level, ensuring the olive distribution is geometrically equitable.
q5.question: You're with friends and no one agrees on pizza toppings. Time passes and hunger sets in. How do you resolve it?
